The dashboard goes blank when the backend has no task ready, shows stale data when state version mismatches, and crashes when the projection is null. This document defines every state the dashboard can be in and what to show for each one.

⚖ LAW: The dashboard NEVER generates tasks, calculates signals, or decides what is allowed. It reads the DashboardProjection from the backend and renders it. Every action button is enabled or disabled based on what the backend returns — not frontend logic.
⚖ LAW: The dashboard must NEVER be blank for a user with an active blueprint. If the projection is loading, show a skeleton. If the task guarantee is pending, show a pending state. Blank = broken.
